ai_summary: ABB India Limited has announced the internal appointment of Mr. Suneel Kumar Munaga as its new Chief Financial Officer and Key Managerial Personnel, effective January 1, 2027. Mr. Munaga, currently the company's Vice President and Business Area Controller (Electrification), brings over 28 years of extensive experience in financial leadership and strategic business control. This move suggests a focus on leadership continuity and leveraging proven internal talent within a critical financial role, with no apparent red flags in the transition.
